serving: Mezzanine to downtown platform
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: For A/C, take an uptown A or C to 168 St and use elevators to transfer to a downtown A or C. For B/D, take an uptown B or D to 161 St-Yankee Stadium and use elevators to transfer to a downtown B or D.
If you are on the platform: Take a downtown A, C, B or D to 59 St-Columbus Circle and use elevators to transfer to an uptown A, C, B or D to 125 St. Or, take a downtown A, C, B or D to 59 St-Columbus Circle. Use elevators to exit the station and take a Harlem-bound M10 bus (Central Park West and Columbus Circle) to Fredrick Douglass Blvd and 125 St. Proceed one block west to St. Nicholas Av.

serving: 125 St & St Nicholas Ave (SW corner) to mezzanine for service in both directions
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: Take a Fort George-bound M3 bus (St Nicholas Av and 124 St) to 167 St for 168 St A/C Station.
For B/D, take a downtown A or C from 168 St to 125 St and transfer. If you're on the platform: Take an uptown A or C to 168 St. Use elevators to exit the station and take an East Village-bound M3 bus (Broadway and 168 St) to St. Nicholas Av and 125 St.

serving: mezzanine to uptown A/C/E platform
shortdescription: Upper Mezzanine to Northbound A/C/E trains Platform level (Front)
busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
alternativeroute:
This elevator is out of service for replacement. Read on for alternatives:
If you are on the mezzanine: Take a downtown A, C or E to W 4 St and use ramps to transfer to an uptown A, C or E. 
If you are on the uptown A/C/E platform: Take an uptown A to 34 St-Penn Station and transfer across the platform to a downtown A to 14 St.

serving: mezzanine to downtown A/C/E platform
busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
alternativeroute:
Elevators at this station are out of service for replacement. Read on for alternatives:

If you are on the mezzanine:
Exit through the faregates and use the elevator to exit the station. Then take a Lincoln Center-bound M20 bus to 34 St-Penn Station for downtown A, C or E service. 

If you are on the downtown A/C/E platform:
Take a downtown A, C or E to W 4 St and transfer to a 44 St-bound M55 bus (6 Av/Waverly Pl) to 16 St, then transfer to an Abingdon Sq-bound M14A bus or Chelsea Piers-bound M14D bus (14 St and Irving Pl) to 8 Av.

serving: 8th Ave & 14 St (NW corner) to mezzanine for A/C/E/L service in both directions
busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
alternativeroute:
If you are at street level: Take a Lower East Side-bound M14A bus or M14D bus to 6 Av for L and F/M service. For A/C/E, take a downtown F/M to W 4 St and transfer to A/C/E.

If you are in the mezzanine: Take a Brooklyn-bound L to 6 Av. Exit the station and take an Abingdon Sq-bound M14A bus or Chelsea Piers-bound M14D bus (NW corner of 14 St and 6 Av) to 8 Av.

serving: Mezzanine to platform for service in both directions.
busconnections: M4, M5, M98 (weekdays only), M100, Bx3, Bx7, Bx11, Bx13, Bx35, Bx36; GWB Bus Station
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: At 176 St and Broadway, take a downtown Bx7, M5 or M100 (176 St and Broadway) to 168 St station for A service.
If you are on the platform: Take a downtown A to 168 St. Then use elevators to exit station and take an uptown M5 (167 St and Broadway), uptown M100, or Riverdale-bound Bx7 (167 St and St. Nicholas Av.) to 175 St and Broadway. Proceed one block west to Ft Washington Av.

serving: 177 St & Fort Washington Ave (NE corner) to mezzanine for service in both directions.
busconnections: M4, M5, M98 (weekdays only), M100, Bx3, Bx7, Bx11, Bx13, Bx35, Bx36; GWB Bus Station
alternativeroute: Proceed to 176 St and Broadway. Then take a downtown Bx7, M5 or M100 (176 St and Broadway) to 168 St station, where A service is available. Take an A train to 168 St, then use elevators to exit station and take an uptown M5 (167 St and Broadway), uptown M100, or Riverdale-bound Bx7 (167 St and St Nicholas Av) to 175 St and Broadway. Proceed one block west to Ft Washington Av.

serving: Mezzanine to Church Av-bound platform
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine:
Take a Manhattan-bound F to Jay St-MetroTech Station. Then, use elevators to transfer to a Coney Island-bound F train.

If you are on the platform: 
Take a Coney Island-bound F or Church Av-bound G train to Church Av and use elevators to transfer to the Manhattan and Queens-bound platform for service to 7 Av.

serving: Mezzanine to Manhattan and Queens-bound platform
shortdescription: Mezzanine to Manhattan and Queens-bound platform
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: 
Take a Coney Island-bound F or Church Av-bound G train to Church Av and use elevators to transfer to the Manhattan and Queens-bound platform. 

If you are on the platform: 
Take a Manhattan-bound F train to Jay St-MetroTech station. Then, use elevators to transfer to a Coney Island-bound F train to 7 Av. 
Or, 
Take a Queens-bound G train to Greenpoint Av station. Then, use elevators to transfer to a Church Av-bound G to 7 Av.

serving: Street (NW corner of 7 Ave and 9 Street) to mezzanine
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: 
Cross 9 St and take a Kensington-bound B67 or B69 bus to McDonald Ave and Albemarle Rd or Church Ave for access to the Church Av F/G station. Proceed to the accessible entrance to Church Av, located on the west side of McDonald Ave, between Albemarle Ave and Church Ave. 

If you are on the mezzanine: 
See a station agent to re-enter through the faregate and take a Church Av-bound F or G train to Church Av. Then, exit the station and take a Williamsburg-bound B67 or Downtown Brooklyn-bound B69 bus to 7 Ave and 9 St.

serving: Mezzanine to platform for Far Rockaway-bound service.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine:  
Use EL480 to exit the station. Then, take a Far Rockway Mott Av-bound Q22 bus (SW corner of Beach Channel Dr and 69 St) to Beach 21 St Terminal.

serving: Street to transfer mezzanine for Far Rockaway-bound service, mezzanine to platform for Manhattan-bound service.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street:  
Take a Far Rockway Mott Av-bound Q22 bus (SW corner of Beach Channel Dr and 69 St) to Beach 21 St Terminal. Then, follow Beach 21 St to Mott Av for the Far Rockaway-Mott Av A station.  
Or, take an Elmhurst-bound Q52-SBS bus (Rockaway Beach Blvd and Beach 67 St) to 157 St and Cross Bay Blvd. Then, travel to 159 Ave and 103 St for the Howard Beach/JFK Airport A station.  

If you are on the mezzanine:  
Use EL481 to take a Far Rockaway-Mott Av-bound A train to Far Rockaway-Mott Av. Use the elevator to exit the station and take a Roxbury-bound Q22 bus (Mott Av and Beach 21 St) to Beach Channel Dr and Beach 67 St.  

If you are on the platform:  
Take an A train to Howard Beach-JFK Airport.  
Then, either:  
Use elevators to exit the station and take an Arverne-bound Q52-SBS bus (SW corner of 157 Ave and Cross Bay Blvd) to Rockaway Beach Blvd and Beach 67 St.  
Or,  
Use elevators to transfer to a Far Rockaway-bound A train to Far Rockaway-Mott Av. Then, Use the elevator to exit the station and take a Roxbury-bound Q22 bus (Mott Av and Beach 21 St) to Beach Channel Dr and Beach 67 St.

serving: Mezzanine to Flatbush Av-Brooklyn College-bound 5 and Utica Av-bound 4 platform.
shortdescription: Mezzanine to Flatbush Av-Brooklyn College-bound 5 and Utica Av-bound 4 platform.
busconnections: B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only)/B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only).
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine:
Take a Manhattan-bound 4 or 5 to Bowling Green and use elevators to transfer to a Brooklyn-bound 4 or 5.

If you are on the platform: 
Take a Crown Heights-Utica Av-bound 4 or a Flatbush Av-Brooklyn College-bound 5 to Atlantic Av. Transfer cross-platform to a Manhattan-bound 4 or 5 to Borough Hall.

serving: Mezzanine to Manhattan-bound 4/5 platform.
busconnections: B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only)/B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only).
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: 
Take a Crown Heights-Utica Av-bound 4 or a Flatbush Av-Brooklyn College-bound 5 to Atlantic Av-Barclays Center. Transfer across the platform for Manhattan-bound 4/5. 

If you are on the Manhattan-bound 4/5 platform: 
Follow signage towards the Manhattan-bound 2/3 platform. Use elevators to exit the station.

serving: Joralemon Street in front of Borough Hall to 4/5 mezzanine level.
shortdescription: Joralemon St to 4/5 mezzanine. Transfer to 2/3 via Manhattan-bound 4/5 platform.
busconnections: B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only)/B25, B26, B38, B41, B45, B52, B61, B65, B103 (westbound only).
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: 
Travel north along Court St to elevator EL317 to enter the Borough Hall station and proceed to the Manhattan-bound 2/3 platform. Follow signage to the Manhattan-bound 4/5 platform. Use elevators to transfer to Crown Heights-Utica Av-bound 4 and Flatbush Av-Brooklyn College-bound 5. 

If you are on the mezzanine level:  
Use the Manhattan-bound 4/5 platform to access the Manhattan-bound 2/3 platform. Use elevators to exit the station.

serving: NE corner of Southern Blvd and E 149 St for Manhattan-bound service.
shortdescription: Street to mezzanine for southbound service
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street:  

Take a NY Botanical Garden-bound Bx19 bus to Hunts Point Ave for access Hunts Point Av station and use elevators to access the Manhattan-bound platform.  

If you are on the on the platform:  

Take a Manhattan-bound 6 train to 125 St. Then, transfer to a Pelham Bay Park-bound 6 to Hunts Point Av station. Use elevators to exit the station and take a Riverbank Park-bound Bx19 bus (Southern Blvd & E 163 St) to E 149 St.

serving: SW corner of Southern Blvd and E 149 St for Pelham Bay Park-bound service.
shortdescription: Street to mezzanine for northbound service
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street:  

Cross E 149 street and take a NY Botanical Garden-bound Bx19 bus to Hunts Point Avenue for access Hunts Point Av station.  

If you are on the on the platform:  

Take a Pelham Bay Park-bound 6 train to Hunts Point Av station. Then, use elevators to exit the station and take a Riverbank Park-bound Bx19 bus (Southern Blvd & E 163 St) to E 149 St.

serving: Street (NW corner of Bushwick Ave and Grand St) to Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy-bound platform
alternativeroute:
If you’re on the street: 

Cross Bushwick Ave and use EL785 to take a Manhattan-bound L train to Bedford Av. Then, transfer across the platform for a Canarsie-bound L train.  

Or,  

Take a Canarsie-bound B60 (Montrose Av & Bushwick Av) to Wilson Av & Gates Av. Then, either: 

Transfer to a Ridgewood-bound B52 bus to Palmetto St & Wyckoff Av,  

Or, travel three blocks north to Myrtle-Wyckoff station. 

If you’re on the platform:  

Take a Canarsie-bound L to Myrtle-Wyckoff station. Then, transfer across the platform to a Manhattan-bound L train to Grand St.

serving: Street (NE corner of Bushwick Avenue and Grand Street) to 8 Ave-bound platform
alternativeroute:
If you’re on the street:  
Cross the Bushwick Ave and use EL786 to take a Canarsie-bound L train to Myrtle-Wyckoff station. Then, transfer across the platform for a Manhattan-bound L train.  
Or, 
Take a Williamsburg-bound Q59 bus (Grand St & Bushwick Av) to N 5 St. Then, proceed two blocks north and 2 blocks west to Bedford Av L station for service in both directions. 

If you’re on the platform: 
Take a Manhattan-bound L train to Bedford Av station. Then, transfer across the platform to a Canarsie-bound L train to Grand St.

serving: NW corner of Lorimer St and Metropolitan Ave providing access to the mezzanine control area.
alternativeroute:
The closest accessible L station is Bedford Av. Travel west on Metropolitan Av to Meeker Av. Take Meeker Av to North 7 St and travel four blocks west to Bedford Av. The elevator (EL359) is located at the NE corner. 
Or, for Canarsie-bound service, take a Rego Park-bound Q59 bus (Metropolitan Av and Rodney St) to Grand St and Bushwick Av. Elevator access to Canarsie-bound service at Grand St L (EL786) is located on the NE corner, elevator access (EL785) to Manhattan-bound L is located on the NW corner. 
If you are on the mezzanine: 
Take a Manhattan-bound L to Bedford Av and use the elevators to exit the station. Travel east on North 7 St to Meeker Av. Take Meeker Av to Metropolitan Av, and Metropolitan Av to Lorimer St. 
Or, take a Canarsie-bound L to Grand St and use the elevator to exit the station. Then, take a Williamsburg-bound Q59 bus (north side of Grand St west of Bushwick Av) to Metropolitan Av and Macri Sq.

serving: Mezzanine to Canarsie-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine:
Use nearby elevator EL777 to take a Manhattan-bound L to Bedford Av and transfer across the platform for a Canarsie-bound L. 
Or, exit the station and take a Rego Park-bound Q59 bus (Metropolitan Av and Rodney St) to Grand St and Bushwick Av. Elevator access (EL786) to Canarsie-bound service at Grand St L is located on the NE corner. 
If you are on the platform:
Take a Canarsie-bound L to Grand St and use the elevator to exit the station. 
Then either: 
Cross Bushwick Av to use the elevator (EL785) for Manhattan-bound service back to Lorimer St. 
Or, take a Williamsburg-bound Q59 bus (north side of Grand St west of Bushwick Av) to Metropolitan Av and Macri Sq.

serving: Mezzanine to Manhattan-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine:
Take a Canarsie-bound L to Grand St and use the elevator to exit the station. Cross Bushwick Av to use the elevator (EL785) for Manhattan-bound service. 
Or, exit the station and travel to Bedford Av (L). Travel west on Metropolitan Av to Meeker Av. Take Meeker Av to North 7 St and travel four blocks west to Bedford Av. Use elevator EL359 at the northeast corner to access Bedford Av (L) station. 
If you are on the platform: 
Take a Manhattan-bound L to Bedford Av. 
Then either: 
Transfer across the platform to a Canarsie-bound L to Lorimer St. 
Or, exit the station and travel east on North 7 St to Meeker Av. Take Meeker Av to Metropolitan Av, and Metropolitan Av to Lorimer St.

serving: Marcy Ave & Broadway (SW corner) to Jamaica Center bound-platform
alternativeroute: If you are on the street: Take a Kings Plaza-bound B46 bus to Flushing Av for Jamaica-bound service. If you are on the platform: Contact a station agent to re-enter through the faregate and take a Queens-bound J or M to Flushing Av, then use the elevator to exit the station and take a Williamsburg-bound B46 bus to Marcy Av.

serving: Marcy Ave & Broadway (NW corner) to Manhattan-bound platform
alternativeroute:
Take a Kings Plaza-bound B46 bus (Broadway & Marcy Av) to Flushing Av for Manhattan-bound J/M service.
If you are on the platform: See a station agent to re-enter through the faregate and take a Manhattan-bound J or Z to Chambers St. Then, use elevators to transfer to a Brooklyn-bound J or Z to Flushing Av and take a Williamsburg-bound B46 bus to Marcy Av.

serving: Mezzanine to Church Av-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: 
Use nearby elevator EL780 to take a Court Sq-bound G to Greenpoint Av. Use elevators to transfer to a Church Av-bound G. 
If you are on the platform: 
Take a Church Av-bound G to 7 Av station. Then, use elevators to transfer to a Court Sq-bound G back to Metropolitan Av station.

serving: Mezzanine to Queens-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: 
Use elevator EL779 to exit the station. Then, either: 
Travel east on Metropolitan Av to Graham Av and take a Greenpoint-bound B43 bus to Manhattan Av and Greenpoint Av. Use the elevator (EL763) to access Greenpoint Av (G) station.
Or, travel one block west to Lorimer St and take a Manhattan-bound L to Bedford Av. Then, transfer to a Long Island City-bound B62 bus (Bedford Av and North 5 St) to Manhattan Av and Greenpoint Av. Use the elevator (EL763) to access Greenpoint Av (G) station. 
If you are on the platform: 
Take a Court Sq-bound G to Greenpoint Av. 
Then, either: 
Transfer to a Church Av-bound G back to Metropolitan Av and use elevators to exit the station. 
Or, use elevators to exit the station and take a Lefferts Gardens-bound B43 bus (Manhattan Av and Calyer St) to Graham Av and Metropolitan Av. Travel west on Metropolitan Av to Union Av.

serving: SE corner of Metropolitan Avenue and Union Avenue  to the mezzanine control area.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: 
Travel east on Metropolitan Av to Graham Av and take a Greenpoint-bound B43 bus to Manhattan Av and Greenpoint Av. Use the elevator (EL763) to access Greenpoint Av (G) station.
Or, travel one block west to Lorimer St and take a Manhattan-bound L to Bedford Av. Then, transfer to a Long Island City-bound B62 bus (Bedford Av and North 5 St) to Manhattan Av and Greenpoint Av. Use the elevator (EL763) to access Greenpoint Av (G) station. 
If you are in the mezzanine: 
Take a Court Sq-bound G to Greenpoint Av. Then, exit the station and take a Lefferts Gardens-bound B43 bus (Manhattan Av and Calyer St) to Graham Av and Metropolitan Av. Travel west on Metropolitan Av to Union Av.

If you are on the platform:

serving: Street (SE corner of 54 St and Broadway) to Forest Hills-bound platform

Take a Manhattan-bound R to Queens Plaza and transfer to a Forest Hills-bound R.

serving: Street to mezzanine
alternativeroute:

If you are at street level: Use other elevator on Queens Plaza North between Crescent St and 27 St.

serving: Street (NW corner of Westchester Av and Lane Av) to mezzanine.
alternativeroute:

Proceed north along Westchester Av to Blondel Av. Then, take a Country Club-bound Bx24 bus to Westchester Av and Amendola Plaza for access to Pelham Bay Park 6 Station.

If you are on the mezzanine: 
Take a Pelham Bay Park-bound 6 to Pelham Bay Park. Then, take a Hutchinson Metro Center-bound Bx24 bus to Westchester Sq-East Tremont Av.

serving: Mezzanine to Manhattan-bound platform.

serving: Mezzanine to Pelham Bay Park-bound platform.
alternativeroute:

Exit the station and proceed north along Westchester Av to Westchester Av and Blondel Av.
Then, take a Country Club-bound Bx24 bus to Westchester Av and Amendola Plaza for access to Pelham Bay Park 6 Station.

If you are on the platform:

serving: Street (SW corner of Jamaica Ave and Woodhaven Blvd Service Rd) to Jamaica-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: proceed east on Jamaica Av and board a Jamaica-170 St-bound Q56 bus. 
Then either:
For Sutphin Blvd-Archer Av-JFK Airport, exit the bus at Jamaica Av and 147 Place.
For Jamaica Center-Parsons/ Archer, exit the bus at Jamaica Av and Parsons Blvd.

If you are on the platform: Take a Jamaica Center-bound J or Z to Sutphin Blvd-Archer Av. Then, transfer to a Manhattan-bound J or Z to Woodhaven Blvd.

serving: Street (NW corner of Jamaica Ave and Woodhaven Blvd Service Rd) to Manhattan-bound platform.
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: Cross Jamaica Av and take a Jamaica Center-bound J or Z to Sutphin Blvd-Archer Av. Then, transfer to a Manhattan-bound J or Z.

If you are on the platform: Take a Manhattan-bound J or Z to Flushing Av (or to Marcy Av if AM rush hour). Then, transfer to a Jamaica Center-Parsons/Archer-bound J or Z to Woodhaven Blvd.
